name: Monica Bony
source:
Major: Graphic Design

This often stressed squirrel is always modest, caring and sweet, even if her statements are often blunt and direct. An experienced student in the art of layouts and typography, she is often seen with Nancy, and she loves spending time with her family. Her favorite website: karaokenow.com.
